cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description:
Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount.

NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method
signatures required by gogoproto.

commitment.description:
commitment, if set, makes the node a bridge: an unlisted entry node.
Its address, keys and disguise are never on the chain; the operator
hands them out as a bridge line, and this is that line's SHA-256, in
lowercase hex, so a line can be checked against a bonded node. A
bridge has no endpoint, pubkey or reality here, and is not probed.

reality.description:
reality, if set, is the node's disguised way in for devices in countries
that block VPNs. Only entry nodes offer it. Nothing in it is secret.

service_key.description:
service_key, if set, is a second account that may redeem this node's
tickets and nothing else. Payment still goes to the operator. It lets the
operator's own key, which controls the bond, stay off the node's server.

sponsored.description:
sponsored is the part of the bond lent by the sponsor pool, in the base
unit of the staking token. It returns to the pool when the node leaves.
A slash burns the operator's own part of the bond first.

smartnodes.registry.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

max_sponsored_nodes.description:
max_sponsored_nodes caps how many nodes may hold a sponsored bond at
once.

sponsor.description:
sponsor is the one account allowed to register sponsored nodes, whose
bond is lent by the sponsor pool. Empty switches sponsorship off.

smartnodes.registry.v1.QueryParamsRespon.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

smartnodes.registry.v1.Reality.description: Reality describes an entry node's Xray REALITY disguise.

port.description: port is the TCP port it listens on, usually 443.

public_key.description:
public_key is the node's REALITY public key: 32 bytes, base64url
without padding.

server_name.description: server_name is the cover site's name, which devices present.

short_id.description: short_id is up to 16 lowercase hex characters, in pairs.

uuid.description: uuid is the published VLESS user id; it grants nothing by itself.

smartnodes.rewards.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

equal_share_min_self_stake.description:
equal_share_min_self_stake is the least a validator's operator must
have staked with their own validator for it to receive the equal share,
in the base unit of the staking token. Zero means no minimum.

max_commission_bps.description:
max_commission_bps is the highest maximum commission a new validator
may set, in basis points. A validator can never raise its commission
above the maximum it set when it was created.

non_voting_addresses.description:
non_voting_addresses lists accounts whose stake does not count in
governance: it cannot vote, the validators it is delegated to do not
vote with it, and it is left out of the quorum. The stake still earns
rewards and secures the chain. The list is set at genesis and can only
shrink afterwards.

smartnodes.rewards.v1.QueryParamsRespons.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

smartnodes.tickets.v1.BridgeRequest.description:
BridgeRequest is a paid request for one bridge line. The ticket that paid
for it was made out to the bridge pool; the line comes back sealed to the
requester's one-time key, so the chain never holds it in the clear.

amount.description: amount is the ticket's price, held until a bridge answers.

bridge_id.description: bridge_id is the bridge asked to answer now.

deadline.description:
deadline is the block height by which it must answer, or the request
passes to another bridge.

request_key.description: request_key is the requester's one-time X25519 public key, base64.

sealed.description: sealed is the bridge's answer, base64, once given.

state.description: state is 1 while open, 2 once answered, 3 if no bridge answered.

tried.description: tried lists bridges already asked, so none is asked twice.

smartnodes.tickets.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

bridge_answer_blocks.description:
bridge_answer_blocks is how long a bridge has to answer a request
before it passes to another.

bridge_handout_limit.description:
bridge_handout_limit is how many people one bridge line is given to
before the bridge is no longer handed out, until it moves.

bridge_tries.description: bridge_tries is how many bridges are asked before a request lapses.

smartnodes.tickets.v1.QueryParamsRespons.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

smartnodes.verify.v1.NodeRecord.description: NodeRecord is what verification knows about one VPN node.

consecutive_fails.description: consecutive_fails counts failed rounds since the last pass.

jail_count.description: jail_count counts how many times the node has been jailed.

jailed.description:
jailed nodes are not probed and are left out of client listings until
the operator unjails them.

jailed_at.description: jailed_at is the block time, in Unix seconds, of the last jailing.

last_pass_round.description: last_pass_round is the last round the node passed, or 0.

last_round.description: last_round is the last round in which reports for the node were tallied.

passes.description: passes and fails count every decided round.

pending_round.description:
pending_round is the last round the node earned a reward share in that
has not been turned into an amount yet, or 0.

pending_weight.description: pending_weight is the node's weight in pending_round's budget.

reward_balance.description:
reward_balance is the reward the operator can claim, in the base unit of
the staking token. It never expires.

reward_paid.description: reward_paid is the total reward claimed so far.

slashed.description:
slashed is the total bond burned for proven tampering, in the base unit
of the staking token.

tamper_rounds.description:
tamper_rounds counts rounds in which every assigned prober reported
tampering.

verified.description: verified is true if the node passed the last round it was tallied in.

smartnodes.verify.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

blocks_per_year.description: blocks_per_year turns the yearly rates above into per-round amounts.

min_entry_mbps.description:
min_entry_mbps and min_exit_mbps are the slowest speeds, in megabits
per second, at which a probe through an entry or an exit node passes.
Every prober judges by these, so all judge alike. Zero means no minimum.

node_share_bps.description:
node_share_bps is the share of each release that goes to verified
nodes, in basis points. The rest goes to the prober fund.

pool_release_bps_per_year.description:
pool_release_bps_per_year is the share of the node rewards pool's
remaining balance released per year, in basis points.

report_reward.description:
report_reward is paid to a prober for each accepted report, in the base
unit of the staking token, from the prober fund.

reward_cap_bps_per_year.description:
reward_cap_bps_per_year caps a node's reward per year, as a share of
its tier's minimum bond, in basis points.

reward_retention_rounds.description:
reward_retention_rounds is how many rounds a round's reward budget is
kept. A share not fixed within this time is forfeited to the pool.

unjail_wait_seconds.description:
unjail_wait_seconds is how long a jailed node must wait before its
operator may return it to service.

prober_ids.description: prober_ids are the probers assigned to the node, if it is selected.

selected.description: selected is true if the node is probed this round.

smartnodes.verify.v1.QueryParamsResponse.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

node_ids.description: node_ids are the active, unjailed nodes this prober is assigned to.

smartnodes.verify.v1.QueryRewardPoolResp.description:
QueryRewardPoolResponse defines the QueryRewardPoolResponse message.
Amounts are in the base unit of the staking token.

address.description: address is the pool's account address.

balance.description: balance is what the pool account holds.

owed.description:
owed is the part of the balance already earned by nodes and waiting to
be claimed.

round_budget.description: round_budget is the current round's budget for verified nodes.

active_probers.description: active_probers is the number of probers in the active set.

next_round_height.description: next_round_height is the block at which the next round starts.

round.description: round is the current round number, or 0 before the first round.

seed.description: seed is the round's random seed, in hex.

start_height.description: start_height is the block at which the round started.
